scope: Reviewed declarative message/host traces; not an executable scheduler or transport

cases.entry: Shared message snapshots score=3; later caller writes score=9; outer succeeds.
expected_trace: confirmed look before commit reads old confirmed score
outer commit updates world; ticket Kept

cases.entry: Player participates at birth then is destroyed; final constraints succeed.
expected_trace: publish frozen payload and canonical Player binding
commit leaves binding inspectable; no final field access

cases.entry: Player is destroyed and recreated after the event.
expected_trace: reinitialisation does not substitute new payload

cases.entry: A validated wave publishes; outer after is false.
expected_trace: published ticket becomes Dropped; payload remains readable

cases.entry: Child confirms at its level after after passes; parent has pending work; no stable-root commit yet.
expected_trace: child relative Success incorporates work into parent level; ticket Waiting

cases.entry: Child publishes, then fails; caller explicitly captures Errors and continues.
expected_trace: parent commit does not resurrect child ticket

cases.entry: Protected block publishes then errors; otherwise succeeds and publishes a new message.
expected_trace: handler occurrence has new identity and Waiting
outer commit keeps handler ticket only

cases.entry: A consequence is jointly caused by two child invocations.
expected_trace: nearest common enclosing invocation owns consequence
child completion leaves joint ticket Waiting
outer commit makes joint ticket Kept

cases.entry: Occurrence is pending in a batch that violates always/domain/cardinality checks.
expected_trace: rollback suppresses occurrence before provisional notice

cases.entry: The same causal event arises in imagine or a fresh isolated test.
expected_trace: internal causal occurrence may drive next wave
no host callback or externally allocated ticket

cases.entry: Submessage or part-only normal message occurs in a real resolution.
expected_trace: no host endpoint or provisional notification

cases.entry: Ticket finalises between host reading Waiting and subscription registration.
expected_trace: transition occurs under serialised state observation
completion is not missed or reverted

cases.entry: Two distinct causal events carry equal fields.
expected_trace: two separate occurrence identities and tickets

cases.entry: Host receives a provisional notice while world remains unconfirmed.
expected_trace: ticket Kept permits irreversible effect; Dropped requires cancellation/compensation

cases.entry: Root produces an occurrence before a next wave exists.
Child confirms relative to its level; parent later refuses after.
expected_trace: child relative Success automatically incorporates its contribution into parent level
caller can observe child Success without stable-root confirmation
parent refusal discards the containing level and incorporated child work
